Higher Education Committee
Thursday, April 11, 2024
3:00 PM or 15 Minutes After Session, G-15 Capitol

Minutes

Present: Senator Omar Fateh - Chair, Senator Aric Putnam Vice Chair, Senator Zach Duckworth, Senator Robert J. Kupec,
Senator Clare Oumou Verbeten, Senator Jason Rarick

Absent: Senator Robert D. Farnsworth, Senator Erin P. Murphy

Senator Omar Fateh called the meeting to order at 5:00pm

S.F. 3667: Senator Oumou Verbeten: Lutheran Social Service of Minnesota assistance to incarcerated individuals to apply for the
Fresh Start Program appropriation.

Senator Oumou Verbeten moved the A-2 amendment, MOTION ADOPTED
The following individuals testified on S.F.3667:
-Becky Pakarinen, Senior Director of Financial and

Employment Services, Lutheran Social Services

Senator Oumou Verbeten moved that S.F. 3667, be recommended to pass and re-referred to the Judiciary and Public Safety
Committee. - MOTION ADOPTED.

Call to order

The meeting was adjourned at 5:15pm

Senator Omar Fateh, Chair Chris Meyer, Legislative Assistant
